format.encoding: text/* only: the WHATWG encoding name TextDecoder gives for the label (utf-8 when absent), or null when the label is not a WHATWG one
format.text: text/* only: the first 40 code points of the decoded text (line ends as in the file), present only when Stalwart and an independent decoding agree; textOmitted says why one is missing
